title: How to add room visualisation to Shopify
description: A room-preview workflow needs a product-page entry point, a room-photo upload and clear product information. Room Refresh provides the photo-based preview;.
answer: A room-preview workflow needs a product-page entry point, a room-photo upload and clear product information. Room Refresh provides the photo-based preview; the merchant enables its theme app embed and approves a subscription in Shopify.
body:
Start with the storefront workflow

Choose one product and one product template to evaluate first. Confirm that the existing product imagery is clear and that dimensions and installation information are easy to find.

Install from the official Shopify listing. Open onboarding and use Enable App Embed. Enable the app’s button in the theme editor, save the theme and return to approve a subscription. These are separate setup steps; an installation alone does not activate the complete workflow.

Test before enabling the whole catalogue

  1. Open the product page on desktop and mobile.
  2. Use a demonstration photo you have permission to upload.
  3. Generate a preview and compare it with both input images.
  4. Check button placement around the media gallery and purchase controls.
  5. Confirm the original product information is still easy to find.

If the button is absent, check the embed, active theme and product settings. Ask support about custom galleries or templates.

Keep the customer decision clear

AI-generated previews illustrate appearance and placement. They do not provide measured dimensions, guaranteed scale or a live camera-based AR view. Shoppers should check product measurements before buying.

Review plans and usage charges, the photo and privacy questions, and the full setup instructions before launch.
